text:
maria_cs: FYI Avira Labs onboarding just spiked — embedding route token burn ~3x baseline in last 48h. We should park a short-term cushion and prep a one-slide QBR note.
leo_finops: Can you share per-route split? need a 7-day projection if this continues. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sam_se: Console grab: /v1/embeddings = 78% of tokens. Current pace ~1.8M tokens/day. If steady, 7d ~12.6M tokens.
maria_cs: OK. Immediate asks: 1) set a temporary budget alert & cushion, 2) route cap for embeddings, 3) enable caching for their index job, 4) schedule enablement for tomorrow morning.
leo_finops: I propose a 20% credit buffer and alerts at 70% and 90% of that cushion. Will also compute cost deltas for the QBR slide.
anya_enablement: I can run a 30-min enablement: explain embedding vs. dense indexing, batching examples, TTLs for cached vectors, and fallback model choices. Morning PT?
sam_se: Avira prefers AM PT. Quick mitigation: switch their indexing to snapshot-based embeddings while they debug query density.
leo_finops: Creating cushion now. runbook-bot: Alert created "avira-embed-cushion-70-90" (ID RB-9112). Conditions: usage >=70% of cushion; escalate at 90%.
runbook-bot: Playbook suggestion:
```
Temporary safety net play
1) add 20% credit buffer to account
2) set route cap: /v1/embeddings -> 800k tokens/day
3) enable prefix caching or snapshot for indexing job
4) schedule enablement + 24h follow-up check
```
maria_cs: Please include a 1-line root cause hypothesis + mitigation + next steps for the QBR slide. Keep it succinct.
sam_se: Draft slide text: "Root cause: onboarding indexing produced dense query mix saturating embeddings route. Mitigation: cached snapshot + route cap + enablement on efficient batching. Expected outcome: burn down to ~0.6M tokens/day post-mitigation."
leo_finops: I'll add numbers: delta in $ and tokens, cushion math, and note retention window for logs.
anya_enablement: I'll record the session and attach the mini playbook (batching snippet, cache TTL recommendations).
maria_cs: Action owners: leo_finops -> cushion + alerts (assigned), sam_se -> route cap + cache (in progress), anya_enablement -> run enablement (scheduled). I'll re-evaluate renewal risk after 24h.
sam_se: Implemented cap and enabled snapshot cache; monitoring in metrics dashboard. (reacted :thumbsup:)
leo_finops: Cushion provisioned and alerts live. Added account note: "temp cushion until Jan 05".
runbook-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 24h (next check 1729957921).
maria_cs: Great work team. If burn falls as expected, we'll remove the renewal flag and include the playbook in the QBR packet.
